# requiredRatio

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The WCAG 2.2 AA ratio required for text of this size, per SC 1.4.3.

Sizes are in **points**, which is PDF's native unit — the CSS px conversion (18pt = 24px, 14pt bold = 18.66px) does not apply here.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
requiredRatio(fontSize: number | undefined, bold: boolean): number
```
